why: 纯 AppKit，零第三方依赖；按键由系统事件回调送达，回调里只做几次比较，切换动作放到回调外执行；配置改动由 kqueue 通知、不轮询，仅每 30 秒确认一次按键监听仍开着。
why_en: Pure AppKit with no third-party dependencies. Keys arrive through a system event-tap callback that only makes a few comparisons, and the switch itself runs outside the callback; config changes arrive via kqueue instead of polling, and a 30-second check only confirms the key tap is still on.

history.reason: 1.2.0 (6) 已实测，不再沿用旧版本数字

1.2.0 (6).reason: 1.2.0 新增给 agent 用的 initials 命令（preview、pause/resume、login、move、cycle、hide-front），菜单栏暂停改走同一暂停通道并写状态文件，状态文件只由写它的进程删除，30 秒看门狗在授权或拦截状态变化时改写状态文件，并修正设置窗左 ⌘ 页离屏快照的窗口高度；按键回调（KeyEngine）未改，字母面板与右 ⌘ 设置页离屏渲染与 1.1.2 逐像素相同。以下数字为 1.1.2 (4) 在 2026-09-29 的实测，仅供参考，1.2.0 尚未重新测量。
1.2.0 (6).reason_en: 1.2.0 adds the agent-facing initials commands (preview, pause/resume, login, move, cycle, hide-front), routes the menu-bar Pause through the same pause channel with a status file that only its writer removes, lets the 30-second watchdog rewrite that file when permission or interception changes, and fixes the window height of the offscreen left-⌘ settings snapshot. The key callback (KeyEngine) is unchanged, and the letter panel and right-⌘ settings render pixel-identical to 1.1.2 offscreen. The numbers below were measured on 1.1.2 (4) on 2026-09-29 and are for reference only; 1.2.0 has not been re-measured.
